title: Observing the Efficacy and Safety of Different Drugs Used in Real-world Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF) Cases
off: A Retrospective Study Observing the Efficacy and Safety of Different Drugs Used in Real-world Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF) Cases
collabs: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
summary: retrospective observe the efficacy and safety of different drugs used in familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) cases in real-world
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Clinical diagnosis of Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) patients (Tel Hashomer criteria)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a history of mental illness, or alcohol and drug dependence；
* Pregnant, with severe infection, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe liver or kidney dysfunction；
* Complicated with tumors, organ transplants, etc. which have significant impact on the immune system or require the use of immunosuppressants.

primary.m: Clinical responses graded as Patient Global Assessment (PGA ) decrease
